description: Apply a character style to text frames, a character range or the selected text, or a paragraph style to their paragraphs. clearOverrides removes local formatting that differs from the style. Without name, the text's current styles are reapplied with overrides cleared (Clear Overrides)

name.description: Style to apply. Omit to clear overrides on the current styles

paragraphs.description: Paragraph styles: Paragraphs to format in each frame: start is the 0-based paragraph index; length defaults to the rest. Default: every paragraph

range.description: Character styles: Characters to format in each frame (or in the selected text): start is the 0-based character offset; length defaults to the rest of the text. Default: all the text

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. Text frames inside groups are included; with selection: true and text selected with the Type tool, the selected text is used

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_text_style
title: Apply Text Style
